pins.title: Op #01: Fishing Shacks Secret Safes
pins.description: Coastal fishing docks in North Grassrivers Basin contain smuggler drop-boxes behind fish cleaning tables. Crack with crowbar and deposit into BuckMe.
pins.tips: Low risk (lone guard). Ideal early loop toward the $5,000 Chapter 1 Family Savings goal.

pins.title: Op #02: Exotic Animals Smuggler Front
pins.description: Gator Mile off-road shed doubling as a cartel courier handoff. Pick the rear workshop padlock for bearer bonds and rare pelts.
pins.tips: Watchdogs + shotgun guard. Clear silently from the marsh side.

pins.title: Op #03: Backroom Weed Dispensary Front
pins.description: Concealed basement grow-room behind a Little Haiti herbal apothecary. Bypass the rear security pad to loot register drops and bricks.
pins.tips: Medium risk. Fence contraband at Randy or Brian's Lockup (7700).

pins.title: Op #04: Industrial Hydroponic Grow Facility
pins.description: North Ambrosia industrial warehouse running 400 commercial grow lights. Override power transformers and load courier duffels into your trunk.
pins.tips: High risk (6 armed guards). Bring a 4-slot getaway vehicle.

pins.title: Op #05: Manatee Motel Safehouse Stash
pins.description: Room 204 safe cracking on Coastal Ocean Drive South. Fleeing bagman left high-denomination currency bundles in the wall AC shaft.
pins.tips: Low risk. Quick solo score right next to Vice Beach ATMs.

pins.title: Op #06: Sunrise RV Park Trailer Stashes
pins.description: Trailer Lot B-14 floorboard cache near Ambrosia Border. Pry loose vinyl flooring beneath the fold-out sofa bed for banded stacks.
pins.tips: Low-medium risk. Slip in at night to avoid patrol heat.

pins.title: Op #07: Brooks Boatworks Marine Smuggling
pins.description: Port Gellhorn Marina Dry-dock #2. Cut open false cigarette-boat fuel tanks to extract offshore bearer bonds.
pins.tips: High risk. Boat exfiltration out of Gellhorn Bay avoids roadblocks.

pins.title: Op #08: June Logistics Freight Warehouse
pins.description: Vice Harbor Pier 9 shipping container consolidation hub. Grab manifest paperwork from the 2nd-floor office to open locked cargo crates.
pins.tips: Medium-high risk. Use suppressed SMG for upper catwalk guards.

pins.title: Op #09: Kingpin Bowling Alley Pinsetter Safe (0300)
pins.description: Crosstown Expressway bowling alley laundering front. Safe tucked behind Lane 12 pinsetter machinery (Verified Safe Code: 0300).
pins.tips: Medium risk. Enter through rear service alley after closing hours.

pins.title: Op #10: La Cascara Motel Drops
pins.description: Cartel dead-drop in Room 108 ceiling ventilation on La Cascara Ave. Pull down the false tile above the bathroom shower.
pins.tips: Low risk. Fast cash pickup with zero gunfire required.

pins.title: Op #11: Downtown Reinforced Stash House
pins.description: Barricaded compound at 14th & Biscayne Alley. Breach steel door, clear 4 armed lookouts, and crack the wall floor safe.
pins.tips: Medium-high risk. Deposit immediately at nearest Downtown ATM.

pins.title: Op #12: Nova Auto Junkyard Chop Shop
pins.description: South Scrap Corridor VIN-tampering racket. Hack master office computer for offshore ledger transfers and cash envelope stash.
pins.tips: High risk. Combine with Moses car-fence dropoffs nearby.
